name: telmoni-observability
description: Records each turn of your Claude Code sessions in Telmoni as a run: the models and their tokens, the tools, the subagents and the times. Never a prompt, a reply, a thought, a tool's input or output, or a path.

TELMONI_API_KEY.title: Telmoni API key
TELMONI_API_KEY.description: A project API key with the ingest scope (tm_…), from the project's API keys page.

TELMONI_ENDPOINT.title: Telmoni endpoint
TELMONI_ENDPOINT.description: Leave empty for https://api.telmoni.com. A self-hosted Telmoni gives its machine host.
